info.title: AliExpress货品编辑API
info.description: Derived from official AliExpress documentation and SDK, not an official Swagger release.

200.description: See the official response envelope and business response fields.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Named API selector; official SDK TopExecutor routing.

scitem_update_request.description: 货品编辑DTO，存在主子店铺关系时，请登录主店铺

biz_type.description: 业务租户Id，AEG场景请填写288000，全托管填5110000，半托管填 7668000

include_battery.description: 是否含电池。1:无电池, 2:内置电池, 3:外置电池

dangerous_type.description: 危险品类型。枚举如下：air_embargo：航空禁运；is_knife：刀具等管制物品；contain_battery：包含电池；pressure_spray：压力喷雾；other：其他

feature.description: 扩展字段, logisticsAttributes 必填。logisticsAttributes 可选值：{"0":"普货","1":"带电带磁","2":"纯电","3":"特货"}

lifecycle_days.description: 保质期天数，isShelfLife=true的时候，这个值必填

delete_supplier_sku_code.description: 是否删除商家sku编码(如果为true则supplier_sku_code字段无效)

request_no.description: 货品创建请求序列号，用于问题排查

x-aliexpress-transport-note: Business object/array parameters may be serialized JSON strings; original trees and field metadata are retained. Do not infer wire locations from BusinessRequest definitions; follow the official page and SDK.

data.codeDesc: invalid scItem Id, please check again
data.solution: 商家核对信息后，重新填写再操作

data.codeDesc: cpfr group info error，please join cpfr group and attempt the operation again.
data.solution: 商家尚未加入协同供应链库存管理商群，请加入后重试

data.name: app_key
data.desc: Unique app ID issued by AE Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

data.name: timestamp
data.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 2022-04-28 10:46:37 (TOP Protocol) or 1651113997000 (GOP Protocol), with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

data.name: sign_method
data.desc: The HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature

data.name: sign
data.desc: Part of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click here for details)
